request-close.title: Request closing
request-close.description: The sender is asked to confirm it was done, and it closes by itself if they do not answer in time.

confirm-close.title: Confirm the request was carried out
confirm-close.description: The ticket closes as soon as you confirm.

decline-close.title: Decline the closing
decline-close.description: The ticket goes back to the unit, open, with your message.

reopen.title: Reopen the ticket
reopen.description: The ticket goes back to the unit, open.

close-without-execution.title: Close without carrying out
close-without-execution.description: The ticket closes without the request being carried out. Explain why to the sender.

setup.title: Ticket setup
setup.description: Set how your unit receives tickets: types and durations.
setup.noManager: This unit has no manager yet: assign one in the organization structure to activate it.
setup.needAdminMode: This page works in platform admin mode. Turn it on at the top of the page.
setup.noneHint: The units you manage appear here.
setup.receptionIntro: Decide whether the unit receives tickets now, and what the sender reads.

receptionHint.active: The unit is listed and receives tickets.
receptionHint.paused: The unit is listed but disabled with a message, and is resumed by hand. Existing tickets are handled as usual.
receptionHint.stopped: The unit is not listed for anyone. Existing tickets are handled as usual.

setup.needsManager: A unit without a manager cannot be activated.
setup.acceptsPersonal: Accepts personal requests (the unit manager does not see them)
setup.descriptionHint: Shown to the employee when they choose this unit.

days.minLeadDays: Earliest date that can be asked for
days.autoCloseDays: Automatic closing after a closing request

setup.workingDays: In working days (Friday and Saturday are off)
setup.typesIntro: Each type has a name, a description, an assignee and an optional own duration.
setup.noTypes: No types yet. Add one so the unit can receive tickets.

type.assigneeHint: The employee tickets are assigned to. Required for a personal type.
type.personalNeedsAssignee: A personal type needs an assignee.
type.dueDaysHint: Leave empty to use the unit's duration.
type.personal: Personal type: the unit manager does not see it, only the sender and the assignee
type.description: The type's name and description are shown to the employee when they send.
type.noAssignee: No assignee: the unit manager handles them
type.deactivated: The type was deactivated because it has tickets.
type.removeBody: The type is deleted if it has no tickets; otherwise it is deactivated and its tickets stay.

setup.durationsIntro: Set the durations in days: usual completion time, minimum lead, auto-close, reopen window and stale tickets.

tickets.title: Tickets
tickets.body: Tickets are the formal way to ask another unit for something: pick the unit and type, write your request, and follow its status and replies until it is closed. Every ticket has a number and a clear path.

can.create: Send a new ticket to the right unit
can.reply: Reply to tickets and exchange files and notes
can.request_close: Ask to close a ticket once it is done
can.confirm_close: Confirm or decline closing a ticket
can.comment_reply: Answer a reply inside a ticket
can.comment_mention: Mention a colleague with @ in a reply
can.setup: Set up your desk, its ticket types and its durations
can.figures: Read the figures and performance of the desks

ticket-new.title: New ticket
ticket-new.body: Open a ticket from this button: pick the unit and the type of request, write the title and details, attach any files, and send. It reaches the person in charge of that unit and gets a number you can follow it by.

can.reply: After sending you follow replies and add notes and files from the ticket page

ticket-views.title: Ways to view tickets
ticket-views.body: Switch here between the table, cards and a status board. The board puts each status in a column so you see where every request stands. Click any ticket to open its page with replies, files and its history. A ticket is not edited once sent; the conversation continues in replies until it is closed.

can.reply: You reply to a ticket from its page
can.request_close: You ask to close it once the work is done
can.confirm_close: You confirm the closing, or decline it if the request is not complete
